'''William David Richardson''' [[Fellow of the Royal Society|FRS]] [[Linnean Society of London|FLS]] (born 18 August 1951) has been Director of the [[UCL Wolfson Institute]] since 2012.<ref>{{cite web|title=William D. Richardson|url=https://www.ucl.ac.uk/wibr/research/neural-stem-cells-development-and-repair/william-richardson|website=[[University College London]]|accessdate=15 March 2016}}</ref>

He was educated at the [[Royal Belfast Academical Institution]], the [[University of Manchester]] (BSc Physics, 1973) and [[King's College London]] (PhD, 1978).<ref>‘RICHARDSON, Prof. William David’, Who's Who 2016, A & C Black, an imprint of Bloomsbury Publishing plc, 2016</ref> He was a Lecturer in Molecular Genetics at [[University College London]] from 1985 to 1990 and has been Professor of Biology at the [[UCL Wolfson Institute]] since 1993.

He was made a [[Fellow of the Royal Society]] in 2013. He is also a Fellow of the [[Linnean Society of London]] and of the [[Academy of Medical Sciences (United Kingdom)|Academy of Medical Sciences]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Professor William Richardson FRS FMedSci |url=https://acmedsci.ac.uk/fellows/fellows-directory/ordinary-fellows/fellow/William%20David-Richardson-0033z00002qIIfRAAW |access-date=2026-06-11 |website=Academy of Medical Sciences}}</ref>
